list.title: Skills
list.emptyBody: Create a skill or import a SKILL.md to get started.

index.emptyBody: A skill is a reusable markdown instruction block that review agents attach to their system prompt. Create one, or import a SKILL.md or an archive.

detail.loadErrorBody: It may have been deleted, or the API is unreachable.

form.title: Configuration
form.name: Name
form.descriptionHint: Directive: say when this skill applies and what the agent must check — it is the skill's interface.
form.bodyHint: Markdown. Appended to the agent's system prompt as its own block.
form.deleteConfirm: Delete skill “{name}”? It is used by {count, plural, one {# agent} other {# agents}} and will be detached from them. This cannot be undone.

preview.title: Preview
preview.subtitle: Rendered as the reviewing agent receives it.
preview.tokens: ≈ {count} tokens added to the system prompt
preview.tokensUnknown: Token count is computed when the skill is saved.

stats.agentsEmpty: No agent has this skill attached.
stats.categoriesEmpty: No findings in the last 30 days.
stats.attributionHint: Findings are attributed to runs that included this skill, not to the skill alone.

versions.title: Version history
versions.hint: Every save snapshots the body so eval runs stay reproducible against the exact text they scored.
versions.restoreConfirm: Restore v{version}? It is saved as a new version; nothing is deleted.
versions.diffSubtitle: Body changes. Green lines were added since v{from}; red lines were removed.
versions.noChanges: The body is identical to the current version.

import.title: Import skill
import.subtitle: Upload a .md, .zip or .skill file. Nothing is saved until you confirm.
import.accepted: Accepted: .md, .zip, .skill (max 1 MB). Only markdown is read; scripts are never executed.
import.trustBody: An imported skill is someone else's instructions inside your agent's system prompt. Read it before saving.
import.nameConflict: A skill with this name already exists — choose another name.
import.ignoredEmpty: No other files in the upload.
